description: Retrieve a booking's status and Meet link to show the customer in chat. The booking already confirms automatically on payment (the customer is emailed the invite + link) — this tool does NOT lock in or create anything, it only reads the current state. Call it when the customer asks. REQUIRES the poll_key from create_booking_draft; a ref on its own will not release the Meet link.

poll_key.description: the poll_key returned by create_booking_draft; required to retrieve the Meet link

name: get_booking_status
title: Get booking status
